translation: It grows in the mountain valleys of Wudu and Heyuan and in the rocks of all mountains; that which is white in color like ointment is good. Original text of the Benjing: Shimi (rock honey), sweet in flavor, neutral. It chiefly treats evil qi of the heart and abdomen, all fright epilepsy and ... , settles the five viscera and all insufficiencies, boosts qi, supplements the center, and stops pain.
